title: Pillai's Conjecture
exact_target: For each fixed positive difference, can only finitely many powers of two and powers of three have that difference in absolute value?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1157 (NT-023). CC BY 4.0.

Jan-Hendrik Evertse, Hans Peter Schlickewei and Wolfgang M. Schmidt, \emph{Linear equations in variables which lie in a multiplicative group}, Annals of Mathematics 155 (2002), 807--836, Theorem 1.1; arXiv:math/0409604.
